invariants.rationale: The method constructs a new TableWriteStats and returns it, so result should not be null.
writeMetadata is accessed in the method body, so it must be non-null at exit.
writeMetadata.getWriteStatuses() is used to construct the result, so it must be non-null.
getStats() of the returned TableWriteStats is initialized from a stream collect, and should not be null.
The stats list is constructed by mapping each WriteStatus to its stat, preserving the original size.
